verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a public REST API covering syncs, models, sources and destinations, backed by a published OpenAPI 3.0 spec with 36 paths, a rendered reference, bearer-key auth and stated rate limits. It also ships an official MCP server that can manage syncs and create them from templates, and API keys can be scoped to a viewer-role group for AI tools. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that sources and destinations can be created (not just accessed) via the API or MCP, explicit API/MCP endpoints for inspecting sync runs and deliveries, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent driving the pipeline.
